stills.label: Still A: proof-play-10m.jpg

puck.evidence: Located at the lower-left center ice just beside orange player 11, visible as an 18 px dark oval framed inside a faint yellowish circular glow on the ice.

carrier.evidence: Orange skater #11 at the center-left is directly adjacent to the glowing puck marker, though neither stick contact nor an attached possession indicator is shown.

team_colours.evidence: High contrast between saturated warm orange and vivid royal blue capsules allows instant distinction across all four visible skaters.

far_net.evidence: Located centrally against the back boards, rendered as a distinct red rectangular frame roughly 120 px wide under a direct vertical beam of light.

zone_strips.evidence: The dark red center line and thin blue lines are clearly visible spanning the ice, although concentric white ice decals slightly break their visual continuity.

stills.first_look: The two large foreground skaters in orange and blue contesting the center line
noise: Concentric white stepped circular patterns on the ice surface
Studio lighting crane, tripods, and film props along the far back wall
Bright vertical beam of light slicing down into the far goal

stills.label: Still B: proof-play-24m.jpg

puck.evidence: Visible as a tiny 10 px dark dot with a faint lime-green halo immediately to the left of orange player 11 near center ice.

carrier.evidence: Orange player 11 near the center circle is adjacent to the haloed puck, but the reduced screen footprint makes possession ambiguous at a glance.

team_colours.evidence: Vibrant orange and saturated blue jerseys remain completely unambiguous across all five visible figures.

far_net.evidence: Red net frame measuring approximately 110 px wide sits squarely at center top, highlighted by the vertical light streak.

zone_strips.evidence: Red center line and thin blue zone lines traverse the entire rink width, partially overlaid by the white lighting circles.

stills.first_look: The two large blue players standing inside the bright foreground spotlight pool
noise: Large overlapping stepped elliptical spotlights painted onto the ice
Studio equipment, cherry picker, and spotlight stands outside the boards
Vertical light beam behind the net

stills.label: Still C: proof-play-40m.jpg

puck.evidence: Reduced to a minute 6 px dark speck inside a barely visible glowing ring beside orange player 11, easily lost against the textured ice.

carrier.evidence: Orange player 11 stands closest to the faint puck ring, but at this distance the skater is tiny (about 45 px tall) and stick contact is invisible.

team_colours.evidence: Bright orange and saturated blue silhouettes are still distinct, though distant figures lose surface detail.

far_net.evidence: Red goal frame is roughly 90 px wide, clearly red but diminished in screen proportion against the wide rink expanse.

zone_strips.evidence: Red center line and blue zone lines remain readable continuous horizontal dividers across the full rink width.

stills.first_look: The wide stadium environment and the bright circular spotlight pools on the ice
noise: High-contrast translucent vertical studio panels and exterior lights along the flanks
Cherry picker, floodlight stands, and prop boxes along the back apron
Intense vertical light streak descending onto the net

stills.label: Still D: play-b-24m.jpg

puck.evidence: Measures around 8 px wide with a faint yellowish circular indicator beside orange player 11 just left of the center circle.

carrier.evidence: Orange player 11 is next to the glowing puck marker, but the small figure size (about 65 px tall) provides weak glance readability for possession.

team_colours.evidence: Distinct orange and blue jerseys provide unmistakable team identification across all visible players.

far_net.evidence: Bright red goal frame centered at the far end is roughly 85 px wide and clearly differentiated from surrounding dark boards.

zone_strips.evidence: Center red line and neutral/zone blue lines stand out clearly against the light-colored ice surface.

stills.first_look: The two foreground blue players framed inside the massive bottom ice spotlight
noise: Prominent circular layered spotlight projections covering the central ice lane
Studio lighting crane, camera props, and stage lights situated behind the back boards
Central vertical light column illuminating the goal area
